decision: Do not begin porting code yet.
basis: Target has no Organization/Tenant, Evidence, CV/JD, CandidateProfile, RoleProfile, Competency, CapabilityGapPortfolio or SemanticPolicy equivalents.
Target Document, LearningPath, Quiz and Certificate models have materially different meanings from source models with the same or adjacent names.
Source and target authorization models differ at the trust, organization and delegation boundaries.
Source and target use separate runtime languages, ORMs, migration engines, queue patterns and response contracts.
The supplied target subtree is inside a parent Git repository whose worktree reports deletions under a sibling source_code subtree.
can_port_with_adapter: versioned instructional-design/evidence contracts after TypeScript schema translation
deterministic normalizers, quality gates and semantic rules after golden-fixture translation
approved learning-plan/course projection through a namespaced adapter
required_clarifications: Which target path/subtree is authoritative: supplied 5. SOURCE/ndt-training-management-system-main or sibling 5. SOURCE/source_code/ndt-training-management-system-main?
Is the MVP single-tenant or multi-tenant, and what is the authoritative actor/employee identity?
Should PAI evidence/capability remain a separate Python service or be reimplemented in NestJS?
Are target course certificates intentionally separate from PAI competency credentials?
Which source concepts are in MVP scope: CV/JD extraction, evidence review, role profiles, capability gaps and assessment?
scan_scope: read-only repository inventory; no tests, installs, migrations, merges or integration implementation
